newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks seen down on finance earnings woes.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks seen down on finance earnings woes.

text.p: Thai stocks were expected to continue declining on Tuesday as investors were expected to unload finance stocks which posted poor first quarter earning results, brokers said.

"Investors are expected to sell finance stocks today. Finance firms which posted poor earnings during the first quarter and are unlikely to improve during the second quarter will be affected," said Thanadech Mahapokai of Book Club Finance. Earnings results of many firms were released today.
The SET index fell 6.02 points to 694.21 on 3.1 billion baht turnover on Monday. -- Suthep Chawla (662) 652-0642
